WITH dd AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2)
),
st AS (
    SELECT s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County'
),
hd AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND hd_dep_count >= 2 * hd_vehicle_count
),
dj AS (
    SELECT ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk, cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number,
               ss.ss_customer_sk,
               COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number) AS cnt,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.ss_customer_sk, ss.ss_ticket_number ORDER BY ss.ss_ticket_number) AS rn
        FROM store_sales AS ss
        JOIN dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
        JOIN st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
        JOIN hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    ) AS w
    WHERE w.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
      AND w.rn = 1
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer AS c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
